scheme_name: Dr. P. G. Solanki Scheme for Loan/Assistance to Medical Graduate Doctors of Scheduled Caste
other_conditions: Applicant must not be employed in a government hospital or any private organization
Benefit is available to only one person per family once
Applicant must start the clinic within 3 months after receiving assistance
Homeopathic doctors must practice only pure homeopathy
benefits_summary: Subsidy of ₹25,000 and loan up to ₹2,50,000 at 4% interest
